hypotheses.claim: The driver face remains spatially inside driver_region but crosses the smallFaceAreaRatio threshold during the turn, so computePersonType labels it BACK_PASSENGER and selectDriverFace rejects it.
initial_support: The source maps a small face inside driver_region to BACK_PASSENGER.
Driver selection rejects stable BACK_PASSENGER and any currently small face.
The board log records driver-face misses and explicit seat classifications.

hypotheses.claim: A turn-induced detection discontinuity creates a new track whose early spatial votes bootstrap as BACK_PASSENGER, losing driver continuity until the frontal face is reacquired.
The face leaves driver_region or enters a competing passenger region during the turn, independently of face size.
